e: I don't eat meat.
I don't drink coffee in the evening.
I don't understand this word.
I don't know where his house is.
I don't want to go today.
I don't sleep well on planes.
You don't speak Arabic well.
Ali, why don't you drink milk?
You don't like fish, right?
Why aren't you eating, Ahmad?
You don't work on Fridays.

q: يَا خَالِدُ، أَنْتَ لَا ___ الْكِتَابَ، أَنْتَ تَنْظُرُ إِلَى الصُّوَرِ.
e: Khalid, you aren't reading the book, you are looking at the pictures.
Sara, why don't you sit with us?
You don't like spicy food.

q: يَا لَيْلَى، أَنْتِ لَا ___ مُبَكِّرًا أَبَدًا.
e: Layla, you never go to bed early.
You don't speak French, do you?
Mum, why aren't you eating with us?

q: أَنْتِ لَا ___ فِي هَذَا الْحَيِّ، صَحِيحٌ؟
e: You don't live in this neighbourhood, right?
My father doesn't drink tea with sugar.
He doesn't understand English.
My brother doesn't work on Saturdays.

q: مُحَمَّدٌ لَا ___ مَعَنَا فِي هَذَا الْبَيْتِ.
e: Muhammad doesn't live with us in this house.
The baby doesn't sleep at night.
My grandfather doesn't hear well.
My sister doesn't eat bread.

q: هِيَ لَا ___ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ عَنْ هَذَا.
e: She doesn't know anything about this.
Sara doesn't read the newspaper.
My mother doesn't cook on Fridays.
She doesn't take the car, she always walks.
The girl doesn't want to sleep.
We don't study in the morning.
We don't eat many sweets.
We don't know anyone here.
We don't travel in winter.

q: نَحْنُ لَا ___ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ بَعْدَ الْعَاشِرَةِ لَيْلًا.
e: We don't go out after ten at night.
My brother and I don't play football.
Children, why don't you eat vegetables?
You don't understand the lesson well.

q: يَا شَبَابُ، لِمَاذَا لَا ___ إِلَى الْمَلْعَبِ؟
e: Guys, why don't you go to the stadium?
You don't speak Arabic at home.
Students, you aren't opening your notebooks.

q: أَنْتُمْ لَا ___ فِي هَذِهِ الْمَدِينَةِ، صَحِيحٌ؟
e: You don't live in this city, right?
They don't know Arabic.
Children don't drink coffee.
Our neighbours don't work on Sundays.

q: هُمْ لَا ___ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ فِي الصَّيْفِ.
e: They don't go to school in the summer.
Students don't talk in the library.
They don't want to play with us.
I don't remember his name.
I don't use the car much.
I don't dance at parties.
You never laugh, Omar!

q: لِمَاذَا لَا ___ عَنْ سُؤَالِي يَا سَمِيرُ؟
e: Why don't you answer my question, Samir?
You don't invite your friends to your house.
Sara, why don't you help your mother?
Don't you swim in the sea?
You don't leave the house before nine.
You don't call anyone in the evening.
My father doesn't watch films.
He doesn't wake up early on Fridays.
The seller doesn't sell bread in the afternoon.
My grandmother never forgets.
The teacher doesn't use her phone in class.
She doesn't sing at parties.
We don't wait for the bus, we walk.
We don't pay by card here.
We don't visit our neighbours often.
Children, why don't you thank your mother?
You don't learn grammar quickly.

q: يَا شَبَابُ، أَنْتُمْ لَا ___ إِلَى الْمُعَلِّمِ!
e: Guys, you aren't listening to the teacher!
They don't help anyone at work.
Children don't swim in the sea alone.
The students don't carry the books home.
You don't leave the house early.
Girls, why aren't you dancing?
You don't invite your friends to parties.
The girls don't laugh in class.
They don't watch TV series.
The female students don't use the computer in the exam.
The two boys aren't afraid of the dog.

q: الْبِنْتَانِ لَا ___ فِي الْبَيْتِ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ.
e: The two girls don't stay at home on Saturdays.
You two don't learn from your mistakes.
I don't believe that this is true.
He never changes his mind.
The city doesn't change much.
My mother doesn't let me go out at night.
We don't celebrate birthdays.
You don't look after your health.
They don't reply to my messages.
The child doesn't stop crying.
You don't memorise new words quickly.
The two friends don't take part in group games.
